report_name: NETSCOUT Reports 1,286% Surge in High-Capacity DDoS Attacks

attack_patterns.name: Network Denial of Service
attack_patterns.description: Attackers conducted high-capacity (over 1Tbps) and short, rate-based burst attacks to overwhelm organizational defenses and cause service unavailability.

attack_patterns.name: Acquire Infrastructure: Web Services
attack_patterns.description: Attackers acquire and use compromised residential IP addresses as a web service-based infrastructure to launch DDoS attacks and obfuscate their origin.

attack_patterns.name: Proxy
attack_patterns.description: Attackers use compromised residential IP addresses as a proxy network to obfuscate the true source of DDoS attack traffic, making IP-based blocking ineffective.

infrastructure.name: Residential Proxy Networks
infrastructure.description: Networks of compromised residential IP addresses used to launch DDoS attacks, making malicious traffic difficult to distinguish from legitimate user traffic.

infrastructure.name: DDoS-for-hire Services
infrastructure.description: Illicit services used by attackers to launch short, high-rate burst attacks designed to evade traditional volume-based DDoS detection.

indicators.name: Potential UDP Flood DDoS Attack
indicators.pattern:
title: Potential UDP Flood DDoS Attack
id: 9b8c7d6e-5f4a-4b3c-2d1e-0a9f8e7d6c5b
status: experimental
description: Detects a high volume of UDP traffic, which may indicate a UDP flood, a common DDoS technique. This rule is high-level and requires tuning and aggregation at the SIEM level to be effective.
references:
  - https://www.afp.com/en/agency/inside-afp/external-press-releases/high-capacity-ddos-attacks-surge-1286-1h-2026-according
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-14
tags:
  - attack.t1498
  - attack.t1498.001
  - attack.impact
level: low
logsource:
  category: firewall
detection:
  selection:
    protocol: 'udp'
  # This rule is intended to be used with aggregation in a SIEM.
  # e.g., alert if count > 10000 events in 1 minute for the same destination.
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects a high volume of UDP traffic, a common vector for DDoS flood attacks as described in the report. This rule is intended for use with SIEM aggregation to detect high-rate floods.
